turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on going to for plans?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Good idea.

For plans we use **be (am/is/are) + going to + base verb**.
Example: She is going to cook dinner.

Exercise: Complete with going to:
"They ___ (play) football next Saturday."
